instruction: All phone text messages and voice messages from 3654328626 are spam, delete them.

steps.code:
phone_password = [p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "phone"][0]
login_result = apis.phone.login(username='8506051563', password=phone_password)
print(login_result)

access_token = login_result["access_token"]
page_index = 0
text_messages = []
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=access_token, phone_number='3654328626', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    text_messages.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(text_messages))
print(text_messages)

page_index = 0
voice_messages = []
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_voice_messages(access_token=access_token, phone_number='3654328626', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    voice_messages.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(voice_messages))
print(voice_messages)

text_ids = [m["text_message_id"] for m in text_messages]
voice_ids = [m["voice_message_id"] for m in voice_messages]

deleted_text = []
for tid in text_ids:
    result = apis.phone.delete_text_message(text_message_id=tid, access_token=access_token)
    deleted_text.append((tid, result))

deleted_voice = []
for vid in voice_ids:
    result = apis.phone.delete_voice_message(voice_message_id=vid, access_token=access_token)
    deleted_voice.append((vid, result))

print("Deleted text messages:", deleted_text)
print("Deleted voice messages:", deleted_voice)
